nodes.title: Let the latest language win
nodes.why: Spanish answers in 700 ms and English in 150 ms. Without a guard the slow Spanish response lands after the English one and replaces it; the flag set in the cleanup makes an old response return without touching state.
nodes.alternative: Keep a request counter in a ref and apply a response only when its number is still the latest.
nodes.tradeoff: A cancelled flag per effect run is the smallest change; a counter also works for requests that start outside an effect.

nodes.title: Derive the filtered lines during render
nodes.why: The starter copied the filter result into state from an effect that depended on the lines only, so typing never reran it. A value computed from lines and query cannot lag behind either of them.
nodes.alternative: Keep the effect and add query to its dependencies.
nodes.tradeoff: The effect version renders once with stale results before it corrects itself; useMemo renders the right list in the same pass.

nodes.title: Restart the clock when the rate changes
nodes.why: The interval callback captured the rate from the render that started it. Listing rate as a dependency tears the interval down and starts a new one that reads the new rate.
nodes.alternative: Store the rate in a ref and read ref.current inside the callback.
nodes.tradeoff: Dependencies keep the effect declarative; the ref avoids restarting the timer but hides a value React cannot see.

nodes.title: Clear the interval when the effect reruns or unmounts
nodes.why: The starter never cleared its interval, so pausing left the old timer running and a second Play added another. The cleanup runs before every rerun and on unmount.
nodes.alternative: Call clearInterval inside the pause handler.
nodes.tradeoff: A handler forgets the unmount case and the dependency reruns; the cleanup covers both.

nodes.title: Clamp the position at the end of the transcript
nodes.why: At 2× the clock can step past the last line. Clamping to the total keeps the time readable and makes "finished" a single comparison.
nodes.alternative: Let the position run past the end and clamp only in the render.
nodes.tradeoff: Clamping in the updater keeps every reader of the position on the same number.

nodes.title: Stop playing once the end is reached
nodes.why: Reaching the end flips playing to false, which runs the cleanup and clears the interval. The clock stops without a second timer check.
nodes.alternative: Check for the end inside the interval callback and clear the timer there.
nodes.tradeoff: Deriving finished from state keeps the stop logic in one place; the callback version duplicates the end condition.

nodes.title: Show the position from the same state
nodes.why: The position line reads the same activeIndex as the highlight, so the two can never disagree.
nodes.alternative: Count the highlighted element in the DOM and show its index.
nodes.tradeoff: State over DOM: the number is right even before the list has painted.
